title: A usable bakery on the shop street
caption: Choose bread with the tray and tongs, pay at the counter, then take it away or eat at the window perch. Open during daytime from day three.

sections.title: Shop, purchase and perch
sections.caption: The existing ground-floor bay now has a clerk, working counter, stock and a real return door. Saved receipts prevent duplicate charges or consumption.
